test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Aggression**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Aggression**" means hostile or violent behaviour or attitudes towards another.
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
 
• The word is a noun and is spelt as "aggression."
 
 
• **Example**: *The country's aggression towards its neighbouring nations led to a war.*
 
 

*​*Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Exports **refer to goods or services that are produced in one country and sold to another.
 
• **Affairs **refers to matters or events that are of public interest or concern.
 
• **Ministry **refers to a government department or a religious organization.
